minutes_text:
Arts Commission

Inglewood, California
  March 19, 2025

  A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission was convened on March 19, 2025.
  Commissioner Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the
  flag salute.

  Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre - District 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle - District 3
   Commissioner Jacques Lesure - Commissioner at Large
  Absent:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf ‐ District 1
   Commissioner Perryman-Banks - District 4

  City Personnel present were as follows:

   Kerri Arroyo  Acting Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

  PUBLIC COMMENTS. Inglewood resident, Katrice Creates inquired about submitting to
  the Local Artist Roster.

  MINUTES. It was moved by Commissioner Alvitre and seconded by Commissioner Battle
  that the minutes for the Arts Commission meeting held on October 24, 2024 and February
  19, 2025 be approved.
  The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Commissioners Alvitre, Lesure and Battle
  Noes: None

  VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  The Acting Library Director reported on the following:
  a. Acting Library Director, Kerri Arroyo presented a visual presentation and an
  update on the Local Artists Roster.
   Arts Commission

  b. Shuree Danyell, CEO of 4KMORE Creative, presented “Culture Cart Wraps as
  Public Art” integrating local art and transportation requesting $12,000 in
  funding from the Arts Commission.

  A motion was made by Commissioner Lesure to table Shuree Danyell’s “Culture Cart
  Wraps as Public Art” project. The motion was not seconded and therefore was not
  considered.

  c. The Acting Library Director, Kerri Arroyo, provided an update on the LA28 Arts
  and Culture initiative, highlighting the City of Inglewood's involvement.
  Commissioners Battle and Lesure expressed interest in participating in the
  process.
  d. The Acting Library Director, Kerri Arroyo presented a memorandum for the
  Percent for the Arts Program Procedures and Guidelines, including the transfer
  of the Arts Commission from The City of Inglewood Parks, Recreation &
  Community Services. The update included a new appeal procedure, a revised
  definition of cultural events, and an exemption for City of Inglewood Municipal
  Buildings. Commissioner Battle requested, for the record, that their concern
  regarding the revision of the definition of cultural events for the Percent for
  the Arts document reflect “all performance art forms” be noted.

Commissioner Lesure made a motion to approve Item #4 on the memorandum for the
Percent for the Arts Program Procedures and Guidelines and seconded by Commissioner
Alvitre.
Ayes: Commissioners Alvitre and Lesure
Noes: None
Abstentions: Battle

PUBLIC REMARKS.
  a. Shuree Danyell, CEO of 4KMORE Creative inquired about the coverage of public
  art funds for private property.
  b. Joyce, the Acting President of Inglewood Open Studios, discussed their goals and
  upcoming events with the Inglewood Public Library.

COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Commissioner Lesure inquired about the programming of cultural events and the
  role of the library in delivering art programs.

There being no further business to be presented, Commissioner Lesure declared the
meeting adjourned at 7:42 p.m.
